issues: The corrected rationale never directly addresses what the reviewed paper actually says. It does not reference a specific methodology section, table, or figure, so it still fails to meet the grounded criteria. The candidate_edit does not fix the core issue: the rationale should explain that the comment identifies a specific part of the paper and specify what is wrong or missing. Instead, the rationale is a meta-commentary on the rubric.

The corrected rationale also does not mention any specific details from the paper. It treats the comment as fully grounded when it is not, which contradicts the requirement to identify a specific area.

The corrected rationale does not provide a concrete suggestion or example to improve the comment. It should at least suggest how to make the comment more grounded, such as referencing a specific table or figure.
